blur_detection.description: The image is clear with sharp, well-defined text throughout the document.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action needed; text sharpness is sufficient for OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: The document displays excellent contrast between text and background with clear black text on white/light gray backgrounds.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: No adjustment needed; contrast is optimal for text recognition.

glare_identification.description: No visible glare or reflections are present in the image.
glare_identification.recommendation: No action needed; lighting conditions appear optimal.

water_stains.description: No water stains or liquid damage visible on the document.
water_stains.recommendation: No action needed; document appears clean and undamaged by liquids.

tears_or_folds.description: No visible tears, creases or folds detected in the document.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: No action needed; document appears physically intact.

cut_off_detection.description: All edges of the document appear complete with no content cut off.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: No action needed; full document content is visible.

missing_sections.description: The order confirmation appears complete with all expected sections present (header, customer info, order details, pricing).
missing_sections.recommendation: No action needed; all essential receipt sections appear to be present.

obstructions.description: No shadows, fingers, or other obstructions visible on the document.
obstructions.recommendation: No action needed; document is free from obstructions.
